title: Open my own file and get a right drawing

screens.caption: A clean file is drawn at once, with a receipt on the canvas stating the mapping in one sentence, a peek at the rows, and Change and Undo.
An unclear file opens the Data page with only the name column and the weight column open for a choice, each with its type and how many values fit.
After Load the graph is drawn with gene names on the nodes, the receipt repeats the choices made, and the Data panel lists the load as its first step.
The fraud file is drawn with one warning on its receipt; the report beside it lists only the four problems found, each with a count, a row and a fix.
The Data panel opens with one summary sentence, the load as a step with its warning, and every column with its type in words, how full it is and where it came from.

title: Find, then show only what matters

screens.caption: Typing padj < 0.05 in the toolbar's find box offers the matching condition, counted 60 of 318, ahead of any name match.
Enter grows the find box into the condition card in place, counting 60 of 318 with Select and Hide the rest.
The drawing shows the 60 nodes with padj under 0.05, and the header chip says a filter is on and how much it shows.

title: Bring in a newer copy, keep my work

screens.caption: Dropping suppliers-oct.csv on the graph shows a small canvas card with Replace already chosen, last month's mapping carried, and Add warning that every supplier would repeat.
The replace receipt reads +12 / -3 / 40 changed, tints what changed on the canvas, names the one style that no longer binds with its fix, and offers Undo.

title: Add a second file to this graph

screens.caption: Dropping expression.tsv on the graph shows a canvas card with the three choices, Add columns to nodes chosen, and the match line with 19 more matching ignoring case and Use.
The receipt names the 4 new columns and the 6 unmeasured nodes (gray and ringed on the canvas), and the Data panel lists the join as a step and expression.tsv as each new column's source.
Export on the table dock opens on the node table as CSV, scoped to what is shown (60 of 318), with one line naming what a CSV leaves out.

title: Fix a column: its type, its role, its name

screens.caption: Clicking amount in the Data panel opens its menu: its type with 1 value that is not a number among 500, role, rename and hide, and each other type says how many values will not convert.

title: Load from a server, expand, load more

screens.caption: Open network data, beside Open, shows the Neo4j form; Test has run and says the query matches 40,000 links before anything loads.
A capped load says 5,000 of 40,000 on its receipt with Load more, and the selected account acct-4471 offers Expand for its 37 links on the server, up to 50.

title: Clean up what the load report found

screens.caption: Cleanup offers sit on the report lines that found them: the repeated pairs are combined (612 links become 607) and listed as a step with Undo, self-loops wait on Keep or Drop, and missing amounts on Fill.
